title: bwf-el-paso-2000-world-heavyweight
label: "The Journeyman" Lance Nelson

won.source: Hotter Than Hell 2001: won a three-way dance against Travis King and Chaz Darby.

how: Rolled up Chaz Darby for the pin in a three-way dance also involving Travis King, in the main event of Hotter Than Hell 2001; by his own account a repeat, not an inaugural, reign.
note: The show's own exact date does not survive in the held record; the promotion's own recruitment history places the return to pay-per-view in August 2001.

title: bwf-el-paso-2000-world-heavyweight
label: Attila

won.source: Meltdown 2001: defeated the champion in the main event.

how: Speared the champion at the bell and finished him with a grapevined leg submission hold in the main event of Meltdown 2001.

title: bwf-el-paso-2000-international
label: The Prophet

won.source: Hotter Than Hell 2001: won the inaugural title in a War Games match.

how: Won the inaugural championship in a multi-man War Games match, submitting every other entrant (Golden Boy, Jade, Kid Sexy, Louis Lowman, Sean Osborne and Dewey) with the Iron Claw.
note: The show's own exact date does not survive in the held record.

title: bwf-el-paso-2000-tag-team
label: Dennis Windham & Lance Nelson

won.source: Hotter Than Hell 2001: won a five-team elimination match.

how: Won a five-team elimination match also involving the Main Eventers, Desmond Walker & Louis Lowman, Slash Richter & Lane Davies, and Suicide Kid & Wasted Youth of 2001: Fear.
note: The show's own exact date does not survive in the held record.

title: bwf-el-paso-2000-tag-team
label: The Deities
how: The Preacher struck the champion Lance Nelson with a lead pipe at ringside; the Deities' Disposable Hero finished with a 450 splash.
